# Reporium

Reporium is a knowledge library that indexes, enriches, and visualizes open-source GitHub repositories for development teams and AI researchers. The platform helps developers discover tools, understand ecosystem landscapes, and analyze repository portfolios.

## Overview

**Live Corpus**: 1,861 AI development tools across 31 categories

Reporium crawls public GitHub repositories, applies AI-native enrichment (categorization, tagging, relationship mapping), and exposes queryable endpoints for discovery and analysis.

**What it indexes**:
- AI dev tools (LLM frameworks, vector DBs, agents, observability)
- Open-source libraries and frameworks
- Developer tooling and utilities
- Research and educational repositories

**Data Freshness**: Daily reindex at 06:00 UTC via Cloud Scheduler

## Public Endpoints

### Get User Repository Portfolio
```
GET https://www.reporium.com/api/repos/{username}
```
Returns all public repositories for a GitHub username with enriched metadata, categories, tags, and statistics. No authentication required.

**Rate Limiting**: 60 requests/hour (GitHub API limit for unauthenticated access)

### OpenAPI Specification
Full API documentation: https://reporium-api-573778300586.us-central1.run.app/openapi.json

## Discovery

- **Sitemap**: https://www.reporium.com/sitemap.xml
- **AI Plugin Manifest**: https://www.reporium.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- **MCP Integration**: Planned — reporium-mcp server is not yet deployed (tracked in #233)

## Data Structure

Repository data includes:
- Basic metadata: name, description, URL, owner stats
- GitHub metrics: stars, forks, open issues, last updated
- Enriched categories: AI taxonomy (31 categories)
- Tags: technology stack and domain tags
- Relationships: dependency graphs and similar repo recommendations
- Temporal data: commit trends, weekly activity, language breakdown

See TypeScript type definitions: https://github.com/perditioinc/reporium/blob/main/src/types/repo.ts

## Attribution & Licensing

Reporium aggregates public data from GitHub. All indexed repositories retain their original licenses and attributions. Repository content is licensed under respective project terms.

Reporium itself: https://github.com/perditioinc/reporium
